A '''skeletal reinforcement package''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic enhancement]] that augmented the user's skeleton with high-stress [[Polymer/Legends|polymers]], increasing [[Bone/Legends|bone]] density, and allowed the user to weather high-impact collisions and withstand more damage.<ref name="GAW" />
